notes.title: Emergency update announcement
notes.notes:
Because we are stupid, there are many bugs of varying degrees in the game. After being fixed overnight, it has been updated.
Please pay attention to the specific update method!
Please be sure to update the latest game before eating the latest pudding to play effectively!

The following is a brief description of the problem solved:
0.Crash problem
1. Picture exchange of neighbor girl and executive massage
2. Take the neighbor girl to the hotel. The neighbor girl does not show up at the hotel, but the executive will show up at the hotel.
3. If you give a massage to an executive without settlement, it will get stuck.
4. Some minor issues

notes.title: 《Handsome Me with 100 Girlfriends!》Officially online!
notes.notes:
After a long wait, the game is finally online!

This is our group's first attempt at making a game with such a large framework, and we expect to make long-lasting updates to gradually enrich the game's content and details, as well as to add some things we didn't have time to do before, such as achievements, cloud archives, flexible setting details, and many other basic details.

Because the framework of the game is quite large, the work of filling in the meat is a bit more difficult to start.

After the game is launched, I hope you can provide bug feedback and suggestions.

And I hope you can come to the Q group to share which profession, city, and character you expect to be prioritized for development, and we'll start to prioritize development based on the ones that have the strongest voices!

We hope we can become a really good game with long-lasting updates!
